headline: StockSathi's ₹499 Basic plan is the top Kolkata threat to KiranaCloud's ₹799 plan
tl_dr: For Kolkata, StockSathi's Basic plan at ₹499/month, with GST billing and 500 items, is the biggest threat because it prices below KiranaCloud's ₹799 [StockSathi-1-1].
BahiBook's Solo plan at ₹399/month for single-counter shops undercuts KiranaCloud's ₹799 Dukaan plan for the same customer type [BahiBook-1-1].
ShelfMitra's Starter at ₹1,299/month and multi-store Growth tier sit above KiranaCloud's price, which limits direct overlap [ShelfMitra-1-1].
StockSathi shipped faster sync on 2G networks on 2026-10-08, with sync payloads 40% smaller [StockSathi-1-4].
BahiBook fixed per-invoice GST rounding on 2026-10-07 [BahiBook-1-2], and reports 50,000 users in Maharashtra, mostly single-counter shops [BahiBook-1-4].
since_last_week: First brief: no earlier week to compare.

threats.rationale: Its new Basic plan at ₹499/month with GST billing undercuts KiranaCloud's ₹799 Dukaan plan, a medium-impact pricing signal [StockSathi-1-1]. The Pro and Business tiers [StockSathi-1-2, StockSathi-1-3] and the 2G sync and dark mode launches [StockSathi-1-4, StockSathi-1-5] add little beyond that price pressure.

Its Solo plan at ₹399/month for single-counter shops [BahiBook-1-1] undercuts KiranaCloud's ₹799 price for the same customer type, a medium-impact signal. Its 50,000-user base in Maharashtra [BahiBook-1-4] is a credible but geographically distant signal, and the GST rounding fix and Pune hiring [BahiBook-1-2, BahiBook-1-3] are low impact.

Its Starter plan at ₹1,299/month sits above KiranaCloud's price and its Growth tier targets multi-store chains [ShelfMitra-1-1], so direct overlap with single-store kirana owners is limited. The purchase-order approval feature [ShelfMitra-1-2] and Mumbai hiring [ShelfMitra-1-3] are low impact for Kolkata.

recommendations.action: Leadership to decide this week whether the ₹799 Dukaan plan needs a response to BahiBook's ₹399 Solo plan and StockSathi's ₹499 Basic plan for single-counter shops.
Product to track StockSathi's 2G sync improvement against KiranaCloud's sync performance on weak Kolkata networks.
Sales to take no Kolkata action on ShelfMitra's multi-store pricing for now; revisit if its plans move toward single-store owners.

watchlist: BahiBook-1-4: reported 50,000-user Maharashtra base; watch for any move into West Bengal.
StockSathi-1-7: pre-Diwali stocking checklist content; watch whether it precedes seasonal pricing or promotions.
StockSathi-1-6 and ShelfMitra-1-3: Bengaluru and Mumbai hiring; no Kolkata signal yet.
